translation_notes: context shims: nanopub_shim.py puts the Nanopublication/nanopub-py@05022dc4bc checkout on sys.path; conftest_shim.py replaces tests/conftest.py and the nanopub_testsuite_connector testsuite fixture, which download the nanopub test suite from GitHub at import time

three files copied verbatim from nanopub-testsuite@main (MIT, (c) 2022 Tobias Kuhn): transform/signed/rsa-key1/key/{id_rsa,id_rsa.pub} and transform/plain/artifactcode-1.in.trig, the only transform case the region uses; the shim testsuite object mirrors the connector API the region touches (.plain.name, .plain.read_text)

the single translatable construct is URIRef(f"https://example.org/ns/{artifact_code}") -> f<https://example.org/ns/{artifact_code}>, which is exactly what the formatted-IRI island is for and reads better than the original

everything else is deliberately Python: the nanopub is built by parsing an opaque trig string (ds.parse(data=..., format=trig)) and inspected with a wildcard quad pattern - neither has an island form, and neither should
the auto-generated draft prefixes dc/rdf/dcterms/prov/xsd were dropped: unused in the region
